title: Agents
subtitle: Configure agents, prompts, tools, and collaboration.
narrowNotice: This page is designed for desktop width; scroll the table horizontally on narrow viewports.
noPromptYet: This agent has no system prompt yet
emptyBody: Create an agent, then bind a workspace, model config, and system prompt.
noMatchBody: Try different search or status, or switch the top workspace.
statusSource: Status comes from agent config; tool/workflow counts are derived from enabled capability bindings.
activeRunHint: Allow production traffic and heartbeat monitoring for this agent.
contextPolicyHint: How history is trimmed for long conversations. Prefer Token window if unsure.
systemPromptPh: Role boundaries, tool rules, and safety constraints…
collabDeferredBody: Delegation, external exposure, and outbound calls require a saved agent first.
collabDeferredHint: After create, open the edit view to configure those sections.
aiEnhanceDisabled: Complete workspace, model, and system prompt first
promptPhCreate: You are the decision owner: parse the business input…
promptPhEdit: Describe how the model should rewrite the system prompt; the server will not echo the current prompt.
weaveHelperCreate: You can enhance before create; apply to draft, then click Create agent to save.
weaveHelperEdit: After preview, accept as a new revision; the live prompt is not overwritten until then.
contextHintTokenWindow: Recommended default: trim older history by the bound model’s window. Advanced options are usually unnecessary.
contextHintRolling: Recommended defaults applied (~20 recent turns + summary settings). You rarely need advanced options.
contextHintDisabled: With window management off, long sessions may slow down or hit upstream limits.
contextHintModelWindow: Set the context window first in Model APIs (e.g. 128K preset).
maxRecentTurns: Recent raw turns (0 = no turn cap)
summaryMinEvicted: Min turns to evict before summarizing
contextAdvancedHint: 0 means no extra tightening. Rolling summary defaults: summary 2048, evict 4 turns, generate 2 passes, keep 20 recent turns.
aapCompactSummary: Return Compact summary body via AAP
aapCompactSummaryHint: Off by default. Affects only new runs for this agent; turning off does not remove protocol plaintext already written to existing runs.
compactionSummaryPermanenceWarning: When enabled, successful Compact summary bodies are retained permanently as PostgreSQL plaintext protocol projections and backups. Turning off only affects subsequent new runs and does not delete existing run bodies.
defaultRoleDescription: Handle after-sales notices, refund pre-checks, and exception escalation
defaultSystemPrompt: Handle after-sales issues in the current workspace; call authorized tools or workflows when needed.
enhanceFailedTimeout: Enhance failed: model response timed out. Please try again later.
enhanceFailedGeneric: Enhance failed: model call did not complete. Check model config and network, then retry.
unsavedChangesWarning: You have unsaved changes. Create/save the agent first, or use Discard to exit.
unsavedChangesToast: Agent draft was modified. Create/save the agent or discard changes before leaving.
enhanceNeedFields: Complete workspace, model, and system prompt before enhancing.
enhancePreviewGenerating: Generating system prompt enhance preview. This usually takes 1–2 minutes.
enhancePreviewGeneratingNamed: {name} is generating a system prompt enhance preview. This usually takes 1–2 minutes.
enhancePreviewStale: Draft changed; discarded stale enhance result. Please enhance again.
enhancePreviewReadyCreate: System prompt enhance preview is ready. Apply to draft, then create the agent.
enhancePreviewReadyEdit: System prompt enhance preview for {name} is ready. Review, then accept as a new revision.
enhanceAppliedToDraft: Applied to draft. Review, then click Create agent to save.
agentSavedNamed: {name} saved. Status will keep updating from runtime signals.
agentSaveFailed: Failed to save agent. Check workspace, model config, and network, then retry.
noChangesToSubmit: Change at least one agent setting before submitting.
fillRequiredFields: Complete required fields before submitting the agent.
defaultAgentDeleteBlocked: Default agents cannot be deleted. Edit role and system prompt instead.
deleteConfirmEscBlocked: Backdrop and Esc close are disabled for this delete confirmation to prevent accidental dismissal. Use Cancel or the close button to exit.
capabilityLoadFailed: Failed to load capability catalog or bindings. Please try again later.
workflowNotPublishedToast: This workflow is not published yet and cannot be bound. Compile → trial run → publish first.
bindingSaveFailedNamed: Failed to save {name} binding. Check release, connection, and data version.
unbindFailedNamed: Failed to unbind {name}. Refresh and try again.
batchNoUnbound: No unbound capabilities available to bind.
capabilityDialogIntro: Tools and workflows are workspace-level capabilities. Here you only manage follow/pin release, connection selection, and enablement. Select items to batch bind or unbind.
batchBindAllTitle: Bind every bindable unbound capability to this agent in one step
noPublishedCapabilities: This workspace has no published capabilities yet.
connectionIdPlaceholder: Same workspace and compatible with the capability provider
deleteAgentBody: Deleting removes this agent and affects its default bindings and available tool/workflow entry points. This action cannot be undone in the page.
typeNameToConfirm: Type agent name {name} to confirm deletion
deleteNameHelper: Must match the agent name exactly. Leading/trailing spaces are trimmed; matching is case-sensitive.
promptSaveReviewAlert: This agent is running. Saving will affect the system prompt used by production traffic. Confirm the diff before applying.
weavePreviewAlert: Preview does not change the agent. Accepting runs the backend enhance command again and creates an immutable prompt revision; inputs and outputs are retained permanently.
adpIntro: Configure how this agent asks peers for help, is called by external systems, and calls external agents. By default only task content is shared — system prompts are never leaked.
adpInternalSubtitle: Hand subtasks to another agent in the same workspace
adpInternalHint: Example: a front-desk agent can ask an order assistant to look up orders. Put the callable name in the prompt; the model invokes it like a tool.
adpTaskContextOnlyTitle: Only task content is shared; system prompts are not shared
adpTaskContextOnlyValue: Task content only (system prompt not shared)
adpCallableNameHelp: Tool name used in the prompt; must start with a lowercase letter, e.g. order_lookup
adpModeHelp: Inline is faster; independent task is more isolated and trackable
adpUsageNotesPh: e.g. call when looking up or changing an order
adpEmptyInternal: No collaborating agents yet. Add one to ask for help automatically in chat.
adpCallableNameHelpStable: Name written into the prompt; avoid renaming once stable
adpModeHelpDetail: Inline: finish inside the current session. Independent task: start a separate task with isolation.
adpUsageNotesFormPh: When should it ask for help? e.g. when order details are needed
adpNeedTargetAndName: Enter the target agent and callable name
adpCallableNameInvalid: callableName must be an identifier starting with a lowercase letter
adpRemoteFieldsRequired: Remote binding requires name, endpoint, and allowedHosts
adpInboundTitle: Allow external systems to call me
adpInboundSubtitle: Expose this agent to third parties / other platforms (inbound)
adpInboundHint: Once enabled, external systems can call this agent via a standard interface. The public name is the card others see; prefer access tokens so it is not open to everyone.
adpPublicNameHelp: Name external systems see; Chinese is allowed
adpCapabilityBlurbPh: One sentence on what I can do
adpEmptyInbound: Not exposed externally; only in-platform chat can use this agent
adpPublicNameHelpShort: How others recognize you — not a technical ID
adpAuthHelpProd: For production, choose Access token required
adpCapabilityBlurbFormPh: e.g. Query and update order status
adpOutboundSubtitle: Connect to agent services outside this workspace (outbound)
adpOutboundHint: Use when capability lives elsewhere: set the peer service URL and restrict allowed hostnames. This agent calls them like tools.
adpServiceUrlHelp: HTTPS endpoint of the peer agent
adpCardUrlHelp: When set, peer capability docs are validated; failed discovery rejects the call
adpSecretRefHelp: Stores a reference ID only; plaintext secrets are never echoed
adpEmptyOutbound: No external peers yet. Configure when you need off-platform agents.
adpCardUrlDiscoverHelp: Peer capability document URL; failed discovery rejects the call
adpAllowedHostsStrictHelp: Must match the service URL hostname to block redirects to unauthorized hosts
adpSecretRefHelpNoPlaintext: Stores a reference only; do not paste plaintext tokens here
